paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a high-Q dielectric cavity
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 8
notes: QUAX-agamma haloscope with high-Q (~3e5) dielectric cavity in 8 T magnet at ~4.5 K, searching around 10.3534 GHz (m_a ~ 42.8216 ueV). Reported best upper limit g_agamma < 0.731e-13 GeV^-1 at 90% CL over a ~1.32 neV wide mass window (42.8210-42.8223 ueV). The exclusion curve (Fig. 8) varies with mass; only the best-sensitivity value is given numerically in text, encoded here as a flat bound across the stated mass window. Assumes local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 50)) | Vision: FIG. 8 shows the 90% single-sided C.L. upper limit on |g_agamma| vs axion mass over a 1.32 neV window centered at 42.8216 ueV. The excluded (blue) region has an extremely jagged lower boundary with narrow un-excluded notches; the traced points represent the alternating spike/notch envelope. The deepest reach (~7.3e-14 GeV^-1 near the center) matches the quoted best limit g_agamma < 0.731e-13 GeV^-1. The red curve in the figure is the expected (no-signal) limit, plateauing near 1.5e-13 in the center. Yellow band is the QCD axion model band with KSVZ (~1.7e-14) and DFSZ (~6.5e-15) lines.
